requirements.title: Preserve inherited scope and branch improvements
requirements.obligation: Retain every mapped parent action and source-backed capability; no competing trading stack.

requirements.title: Admit complete targets and market scope
requirements.obligation: Resolve target units, cohorts, providers, required plugins, consumers and budget before implementation.

requirements.title: Respect independent F15 and backend-first authority
requirements.obligation: No code-bearing child may start before current parent F15 and source admission; frontend also requires global BG.

requirements.title: Lock tested libraries and isolate computation
requirements.obligation: Produce reproducible environment manifests and actual VM compatibility evidence without loading training stacks in T0.

requirements.title: Point-in-time source availability
requirements.obligation: Every feature source has event and availability timestamps, revision identity and provenance quality.

requirements.title: Survivorship and instrument identity
requirements.obligation: Universe and contract membership are as-of; canonical identity includes venue and contract, not ticker alone.

requirements.title: Calendar and bar completeness
requirements.obligation: Use closed observed bars and per-market session/business-time horizons with gap policy.

requirements.title: Single feature definition and offline-online parity
requirements.obligation: Reuse the VAN feature owner, version transformations and materialize Feast views without alternate T0 authority.

requirements.title: Train-only transforms and aligned row masks
requirements.obligation: Fit scalers, PCA, feature selection and outlier transforms only inside training boundaries; preserve X/y/weight alignment.

requirements.title: Controlled feature expansion
requirements.obligation: Lag, timeframe, peer and calendar features use an admitted DAG and measured feature budget.

requirements.title: Target maturity and event semantics
requirements.obligation: Every label records interval, available_at, cost treatment, censoring and target version.

requirements.title: Separate facts, practice and counterfactuals
requirements.obligation: Do not mix actual fills, paper/practice, inferred outcomes and synthetic fixtures in promotion statistics.

requirements.title: Return, ranking, volatility and cost targets
requirements.obligation: Provide all requested target families with correct domain and units; no binary-option payoff guessed as linear return.

requirements.title: Purged chronological validation
requirements.obligation: Purge overlapping label intervals across training/validation/calibration/test; synchronize cohort cutoffs.

requirements.title: Bias and warmup diagnostics
requirements.obligation: Build native lookahead/prefix and indicator-recursion checks; poison tests must demonstrate sensitivity.

requirements.title: Immutable final holdout and trial census
requirements.obligation: Pre-register holdout access and count architectures/features/horizons/calibrators tried, including failures.

requirements.title: Direction-neutral intrabar uncertainty
requirements.obligation: Use observed subbars/ticks or declared feasible market scenarios; never claim a long-only path is conservative for all sides.

requirements.title: Economic cost and valuation accounting
requirements.obligation: Debit monetary costs once and use realizable prices, latency, partial fills and post-liquidation equity.

requirements.title: Flow-adjusted and open-position risk metrics
requirements.obligation: Preserve cash-flow-neutral performance and current collateral/MTM drawdown as separate measurements.

requirements.title: Account-wide research-live parity
requirements.obligation: Use the real account coordinator and policy interfaces with isolated execution and reservation state.

requirements.title: Nonvacuous deterministic evidence
requirements.obligation: Determinism concerns specified events/decisions, not just final trade count or zero-checked replay.

requirements.title: Qlib model boundary and processor configuration
requirements.obligation: Use custom VAN data handlers; configure processor fitting, DK_L/DK_I and Recorder explicitly; no Qlib execution runtime.

requirements.title: LightGBM regression production adapter
requirements.obligation: Implement per-target/horizon expected-return/net-edge models and native export with exact transform manifest.

requirements.title: Calibratable setup classification
requirements.obligation: Implement binary target models with defined population and raw-probability semantics before separate calibration.

requirements.title: Quantile adapter completeness
requirements.obligation: Implement separate quantile/horizon objectives outside unsupported stock Qlib loss API.

requirements.title: Grouped ranking correctness
requirements.obligation: Train ranking with cutoff/universe query groups and appropriate nonnegative relevance coding; report ordinal scores.

requirements.title: Meaningful baseline and challenger comparisons
requirements.obligation: Implement XGBoost and simple/statistical incumbents against identical targets and calendars.

requirements.title: NeuralForecast shared data contract
requirements.obligation: Map unique_id/ds/y and exogenous inputs with immutable cutoffs and fold-scoped scalers.

requirements.title: N-HiTS complete research integration
requirements.obligation: Implement real NHITS training, multi-horizon inference, model persistence and shared provenance.

requirements.title: N-BEATSx contextual and interpretability integration
requirements.obligation: Implement supported exogenous inputs and optional native decomposition with noncausal explanations.

requirements.title: DeepAR distribution and path integration
requirements.obligation: Implement domain-valid distributions and retained individual temporal samples with seeds.

requirements.title: Complete challenger plugin interfaces
requirements.obligation: Implement TFT, PatchTST and iTransformer research plugins, gated by verified per-model capability matrix.

requirements.title: Reuse existing conformal ownership
requirements.obligation: Extend existing vati.risk.conformal and source-bound calibration producer; no independent sizing permission.

requirements.title: Honest probability and interval calibration
requirements.obligation: Validate disjoint calibration, empirical coverage and adequacy; label marginal/conditional limitations.

requirements.title: Calibration lineage and tail semantics
requirements.obligation: Bind calibration to exact model/transform/target; avoid unsupported joint-tail, stop-touch and transformed-mean claims.

requirements.title: One bounded optimization control
requirements.obligation: Use one Optuna/trial budget across Qlib/NF; all optimization only creates candidates.

requirements.title: Safe artifact and supply-chain boundary
requirements.obligation: Use native LightGBM and vetted safe neural formats; allowlisted loaders verify immutable bytes.

requirements.title: Registry is not authority
requirements.obligation: MLflow aliases and experiment status never grant forecast influence or strategy promotion.

requirements.title: Durable adaptive retraining
requirements.obligation: Implement per-scope jobs, cadence/drift triggers, leases, retries, checkpoints and safe cancellation.

requirements.title: Prevent schedule and resource starvation
requirements.obligation: Coalesce obsolete retrains with explicit receipts, bound queue/threads and protect serving/T0 capacity.

requirements.title: Typed forecast service and complete provenance
requirements.obligation: Emit ForecastPacket or abstention with scope, cutoffs, target, model, transformation and source evidence.

requirements.title: Independent freshness and OOD checks
requirements.obligation: Validate model age, data age, calibration age and novelty as separate dimensions.

requirements.title: Nonblocking inference and immutable cache
requirements.obligation: Preload admitted artifacts and cache by all material identities; T0 never awaits training/registry/network.

requirements.title: OOF-only forecast fusion and redundancy control
requirements.obligation: Learn combination only from out-of-fold predictions and track shared information across models.

requirements.title: Preserve trading and financial authority
requirements.obligation: Models propose evidence only; only existing RiskAuthority sizes and ExecutionRouter sends orders.

requirements.title: Independent edge evidence and mode integration
requirements.obligation: Supply real economic-evidence producer and signed scope binding for Normal/Risky/Aggressive policy use.

requirements.title: Complementary suppression without duplicate risk governor
requirements.obligation: Implement per-instrument/strategy cooldown and loss/profit protections through existing risk controls.

requirements.title: Outcome attribution and scientific data moat
requirements.obligation: Join all eligible candidates and model outputs to observed decisions/outcomes and label unobserved counterfactuals.

requirements.title: Privacy and correction propagation
requirements.obligation: Respect entitlements/consent; invalidate downstream datasets/models when affected source is corrected/revoked.

requirements.title: Every capability has a genuine caller and readback
requirements.obligation: Publish complete catalog/actions/error states and actual gateway operations without new frontend implementation.

requirements.title: Truthful confidence and explanation surfaces
requirements.obligation: Keep raw rank/rule score, calibrated event probability, intervals and economic evidence distinct.

requirements.title: Authorized VM deployment and recovery
requirements.obligation: Use qualified Global DIAL/Zuul execution routes, exact source, resource admission and tested isolation.

requirements.title: Bounded capacity and observability
requirements.obligation: Measure real CPU/memory/latency/disk and keep risk/protection independent of research load.

requirements.title: Actual statistical and economic evaluation
requirements.obligation: Use matched OOS forecasts, costs, intervals, DSR/PBO where applicable and pre-registered uncertainty analysis.

requirements.title: Real shadow pipeline and full rejection path
requirements.obligation: Exercise the real pipeline in shadow/sandbox and preserve prospective timestamped outcomes.

requirements.title: Independent complete additive backend closure
requirements.obligation: All mandatory backend engineering must have real source/service/caller/failure evidence.

requirements.title: Global backend barrier and contract renewal
requirements.obligation: Integrate with all parent backend/BQ obligations; renew BG before any new UX/frontend.

requirements.title: Complete post-backend UI integration
requirements.obligation: Apply every forecast capability/state/action in appropriate existing native screen families after BG.

requirements.title: Physical and whole-product final acceptance
requirements.obligation: Actual S24 and signed app use the qualified backend and preserve all inherited actions.

requirements.title: Separate software release from live-model promotion
requirements.obligation: Release software by parent policy; live influence requires independent model/strategy/account admission and owner authority.

requirements.title: Separate deployment, source access and procurement
requirements.obligation: Record Netcup/Oracle execution profiles; no licence procurement or external spending in this phase; no inference that VM location establishes operator eligibility.

requirements.title: Non-blocking no-procurement development path
requirements.obligation: Provide implemented fixture/replay and provider-adapter paths; source-use status is scoped; absent purchased licence cannot block ordinary specification, coding or fixture validation.

requirements.title: Versioned bounded read-only adapters
requirements.obligation: Implement allowlisted market-data REST and optional read-only streaming with pinned contract revisions, timeouts, rate budgets and cursor handling; no order/account mutations.

requirements.title: Point-in-time archive and live completeness
requirements.obligation: Store publication/receive/availability clocks and per-record historical cutoffs; dedupe and reconcile archive handoffs without inventing past receipt times.

requirements.title: Exact bid and ask conversion
requirements.obligation: Parse fixed-point price/quantity strings and derive YES asks from NO bids and vice versa; retain source book and executable depth.

requirements.title: Stream gap and sequence recovery
requirements.obligation: Apply sequence-aware deltas idempotently; gaps, negative resulting depth or duplicate mismatches force INVALID until full resynchronization.

requirements.title: Canonical event and proposition identity
requirements.obligation: Bind thresholds/comparators, units, timezones, official source/vintage and rules digest; distinguish exact, complement, overlapping and non-equivalent contracts.

requirements.title: Resolution and cash settlement are separate
requirements.obligation: Track occurrence, release, close, provisional outcome, dispute/cancel and final settlement separately; corrections create versions.

requirements.title: Maturity-aware contract continuity
requirements.obligation: Key probability changes by event/proposition/horizon and explicit roll rule; missing successor contracts produce missing features.

requirements.title: Coherent distributions without fabricated tails
requirements.obligation: Differentiate mutually exclusive bins from overlapping thresholds; monotonicity, mass, open-tail and adjustment policies are explicit.

requirements.title: Quality-aware market-implied estimates
requirements.obligation: Track estimator type, depth, spread, age, activity and rule coherence separately from calibration; empty books produce missing observations.

requirements.title: Freeze expectations before official information
requirements.obligation: Link each surprise to the last genuinely available pre-release snapshot and official release vintage; no future availability.

requirements.title: Two-source agreement is not independence
requirements.obligation: Preserve parent Kalshi/Polymarket liquidity/agreement rules for armed expectations; matching horizons and semantic relation required; no independent-evidence multiplication.

requirements.title: Event-grouped calibration and adequate evidence
requirements.obligation: Calibrate by declared event family/horizon/cohort with matured labels; group dependent snapshots/contracts and report effective event counts and uncertainty.

requirements.title: Preserve probability meaning
requirements.obligation: Market-implied estimate, calibrated physical-event probability, asset outcome probability and rank score are distinct types and fields.

requirements.title: Correct Qlib and neural event-feature adapters
requirements.obligation: Feed as-of event features to existing Qlib/LightGBM tasks and supported NeuralForecast historical covariates; future calendar use is versioned and not future probabilities.

requirements.title: Conditional asset response and incremental information
requirements.obligation: Estimate event-to-instrument outcomes under context, timing and horizon; compare against conventional market/news/calendar features and use OOF fusion.

requirements.title: Preserve D1–D7 and manual ownership
requirements.obligation: External information affects entries/ranking/lifecycle only through inherited rules; D7 is required for news-generated added risk; existing risk authority sizes.

requirements.title: Net executable binary-contract value
requirements.obligation: For held-to-settlement use expected payout minus actual entry costs/fees/lockup; for early exit use executable exit distribution; market price is not independent edge.

requirements.title: Full event-loss and portfolio stress
requirements.obligation: Model maximum binary outlay, related event exposures and uncertain probabilities; Kelly-style analysis remains a bounded sandbox proposal, never sizing authority.

requirements.title: Exact fees and complete settlement accounting
requirements.obligation: Use revision/series/account-specific fee rules, per-fill precision/accumulator, cash reservations and all relevant settlement/conversion costs.

requirements.title: Queue-aware feasible event execution
requirements.obligation: Model real observation/decision/order latency, depth, partial fills, queue uncertainty and cancel races; sparse data cannot prove maker profitability.

requirements.title: Payoff-proven contract consistency
requirements.obligation: Enumerate permissible resolution/void/dispute states and quantities; exact/complement matching precedes worst-case net-payoff assessment.

requirements.title: Non-atomic multi-venue risk and capital
requirements.obligation: Keep venue-specific balances, collateral/currency conversion and hedge-failure unwind costs; no instant cross-venue capital or fill assumption.

requirements.title: Inventory-aware event quoting laboratory
requirements.obligation: Implement bounded quoting policies with event-family inventory, jump risk, adverse selection and value conditional on fills; no direct live execution.

requirements.title: Maker quote lifecycle and protective withdrawal
requirements.obligation: Simulate pending/new/partial/cancel/unknown quote states, stale-feed reduction and scheduled-event withdrawal without manipulating markets.

requirements.title: Four preregistered incremental-value studies
requirements.obligation: Implement risk-filter, surprise, volatility and ranking studies with identical opportunity sets, incumbent/calendar/exposure-matched controls and frozen utility.

requirements.title: Prospective sealing and dependent uncertainty
requirements.obligation: Seal issued forecasts before outcomes, use event/time-block inference and full trial census; compare realistic lags and negative controls.

requirements.title: Complete owner projections and operator controls
requirements.obligation: Extend existing event/research/work/evidence/settings and later native surfaces with source state, expectation lineage, study/lab controls, calibration and per-use outcomes.

requirements.title: Failure isolation and truthful full-backend closure
requirements.obligation: Isolate event workers from T0 and finance; complete recovery, revocation and rollback; all new backend obligations feed existing gates without purchasing licences or fabricating access.
